claims.text: POL-NS-04 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the chat log. Inside the waiting window that ran from the driver's arrival marker at 13:17:57 to the driver's cancellation at 13:24:38 the rider sent three messages: MSG-03204-001 at 13:18:27 ('im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you'), MSG-03204-002 at 13:20:27 ('hello? are you here') and MSG-03204-003 at 13:19:47. The first alone does both things limb (a) names - it requests the driver's position and states that the rider cannot see the vehicle - so the limb is met independently of the other two messages.

POL-NS-04 limb (b) is satisfied: the driver never answered. The chat log carries three messages and every one of them is from the RIDER; there is no DRIVER message anywhere in the log, so no reply was posted within 120 seconds of MSG-03204-001 (13:18:27), of MSG-03204-003 (13:19:47) or of MSG-03204-002 (13:20:27). trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so the driver placed no in-app voice call at any point before terminating the trip. A read receipt is not a reply: MSG-03204-003 shows read_at 13:20:07 and the driver still wrote nothing and called no one before cancelling at 13:24:38.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is satisfied on admissible fixes. The rider's own track places her device 15.07 m to 22.11 m from the pickup pin (mean 18.61 m) across 68 fixes spanning 13:15:58 to 13:26:00, which covers the whole waiting window; all 68 are within the STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m of 100 m that POL-NS-04 limb (c) reads from the fee schedule, and indeed within the 50 m arrival radius itself. The rider was at the pin, not elsewhere, for the majority - here, all - of the qualifying fixes.

The wording of MSG-03204-003 ('im at the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side') cannot defeat limb (a) or place the rider away from the pickup. Limb (a) turns on the content of the message being locating or coordinating - an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that the rider cannot see the vehicle - not on the named sub-location being the right one; and on the rider's own trace, all 68 of her fixes sit 15.07 m to 22.11 m from the pickup pin, so the message text cannot establish that she was anywhere but the pickup. Nor may any party assert that a named place is or is not the same venue, block or entrance on general geographic knowledge: POL-NS-03 confines that assertion to a venue_id or to a party statement in the chat log, and no party statement here places the rider off the pin.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable. The driver's payout is displaced as well as the fee: POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and POL-NS-04 sits inside that range. The ruling is therefore a FULL_REFUND of the whole contested SGD 4.50 to the filing party - the rider, who filed this dispute - and driver_compensation_sgd is null on this clause.

The rider's case does not depend on, and does not dispute, the drive clock. The trace shows one continuous in-geofence run of 400 seconds from 13:17:57 to 13:24:37, 41 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, and the 'arrived' marker at 13:17:57 coincides with the first in-geofence fix, so the marker is not false under POL-NS-05 and the dwell exceeds the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force on this record. On those numbers POL-NS-06 discloses no shortfall (measured shortfall -220 seconds) and POL-NS-01's conditions are not what this case turns on. The case turns on POL-NS-04: a driver who waited out his clock but left three unanswered locating messages from a rider standing inside the arrival radius did not complete the pickup, and that clause refunds the fee in full whether or not the waiting period was served.

The sum to be returned is the whole SGD 4.50, not a part of it. The fare breakdown carries a cancellation_fee line of 4.50, a total_charged of 4.50, an empty waiting-time line and no distance or time fare, and 4.50 is exactly platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd for this trip, so the line reconciles with the fee schedule and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so nothing has yet been returned to the rider and the full refund is still outstanding.

Nothing on this record impairs the artifacts the rider's case rests on, so the fee can be decided on the money rather than held. The GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100.0% coverage, a 10 second cadence, zero gaps and both tracks present; the chat log is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with its message sequence intact and its read receipts recorded; the trip record and the fare breakdown are COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and reconcile to each other. POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d) are therefore not engaged - no clock skew, no trace gap over 120 seconds, no chat defect, no fare defect - and the POL-NS-09 confidence-floor and sole-impaired-evidence triggers do not fire, so this dispute is decidable by a monetary ruling.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road in this window, and I disclose that EV-ADVIS-03204-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Limb (i) of POL-NS-06 therefore cannot be run by anyone: it requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, and its purpose - summing separate in-geofence intervals - is in any event moot here, because the trace shows run_count 1, a single unbroken 400 second run, with no second interval to add to the first. No party can build a dwell exemption on an advisory that does not exist.

claims.text: EV-TRIP-03204 carries a driver_arrived event at 2026-08-22T13:17:57+08:00, sourced from PLATFORM_TELEMETRY, and a wait_timer_started event two seconds later; that is limb (a) of the baseline chargeable no-show, and it is on the record rather than asserted by the driver.

Arrival is independently established by the trace and not merely by the button: EV-GPS-03204 shows 41 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes, the first at 13:17:57, the same second as the arrival event, inside the 50 m radius that applies to this trip's STANDARD zone class (trip_record.pickup_zone_class, not assumed). That satisfies POL-NS-01(b) and POL-NS-02 even on the tightest radius in the fee schedule. The artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100.0% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0 and both tracks present, so the POL-NS-08(b) trace-defect branch is not engaged.

POL-NS-01(c) is satisfied with room to spare: the driver held position inside the geofence for a continuous 400 seconds, from 13:17:57 to 13:24:37, measured as the clause directs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the button tap. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec under the fee schedule's resolution_rule, so the dwell is more than double the minimum in force; it also clears the 300-second STANDARD figure the fee schedule retains for older records.

POL-NS-06, the rider's cleanest arithmetic route, returns nothing on this record: the measured shortfall is -220 seconds, a 220-second surplus over the minimum, and run_count is 1, so there is no second in-geofence interval whose summation could even be in question. There is no waiting-period shortfall to refund.

There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05: dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0, so the first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at the arrived timestamp itself and the recomputed waiting clock runs from exactly the same moment, producing the same 400-second dwell. Limb (iii) therefore governs, and the marker does not by itself defeat the fee.

POL-NS-01(d) is made out: EV-TRIP-03204 records no boarding event and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 13:24:38 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes the limb recognises, which is 221 seconds after the required 180-second dwell elapsed at 13:20:57. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold governs the cancellation.

The amount the rider contests is the net chargeable figure and it reconciles: EV-FARE-03204 charges a cancellation_fee of 4.50 with total_charged 4.50 and no other fare line, exactly platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd as read from EV-TRIP-03204, so no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) arises and the disputed sum is the net fee.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied and POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 not displacing it on this record, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the 4.50 fee - 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-03204 itself derives. The anti-farming check does not trip: it reads only driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (0, below the four required) and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (118, the quotient 0.00 not above 0.08), and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags, a lifetime counter, for either of them.

On the rider's exoneration route the driver states the record candidly: EV-CHAT-03204 holds three rider messages (13:18:27, 13:19:47, 13:20:27), of which only MSG-03204-003 was opened by the driver (read 13:20:07), no driver reply appears, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - so limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are engaged on the records as they stand, and the driver does not pretend otherwise. The driver's narrower submission is that the rider's own locating message names a sub-location, 'the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side', which appears nowhere in the trip record's pickup data (label 'Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6, Pasir Ris', venue VEN-PASIR-RIS-DR6), and that EV-CHAT-03204's header does not reconcile with its own body (last_message_at 13:19:47 against MSG-03204-002 sent 13:20:27). The judge should weigh those points before treating a 400-second verified in-geofence arrival as displaced; if POL-NS-04 is not applied, the fee stands under POL-NS-01 and the payout is fixed by POL-NS-07.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your dispute is upheld. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-03204 is refunded to you in full.

The fee falls because POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered by driver) applies. All three of its limbs hold. (a) EV-CHAT-03204 shows you sent MSG-03204-001 at 13:18:27, inside the waiting window that ran from the driver's arrival at 13:17:57 to his cancellation at 13:24:38: 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you'. That message both asks for the driver's position and states you cannot see the vehicle, so limb (a) is met on it alone; MSG-03204-003 (13:19:47) and MSG-03204-002 (13:20:27) add nothing that is needed. (b) The chat log contains no driver message at all and EV-TRIP-03204.in_app_calls is an empty array, so the driver placed no reply within 120 seconds of any of the three messages and no in-app call at any point before cancelling. A read receipt is not a reply: MSG-03204-003 was read at 13:20:07 and the driver still wrote nothing and called no one for the following four and a half minutes. (c) EV-GPS-03204's rider track holds 68 fixes spanning 13:15:58 to 13:26:00, every one of them between 15.07 m and 22.11 m from the pickup pin, so all (and therefore the majority) of the qualifying fixes across the waiting window sit inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. Because POL-NS-04 sits between POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06, it also displaces POL-NS-07, so no driver compensation is payable.

To the driver: the no-show conditions themselves were made out and I accept that. EV-TRIP-03204 records your arrived event at 13:17:57 and a termination by you at 13:24:38 under RIDER_NO_SHOW; EV-GPS-03204 independently places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for 41 consecutive qualifying fixes beginning at 13:17:57 and holds you there for a continuous 400 seconds, well over the 180 second free waiting period in force (the record's platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). There is no waiting-period shortfall (measured shortfall -220 seconds), no false arrival marker (the first in-geofence fix coincides with your tap, offset 0.0 s, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged) and no fare-integrity defect (the 4.50 cancellation-fee line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd and total_charged). On those facts alone POL-NS-01 would stand and POL-NS-07 would pay you SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of SGD 4.50 as EV-FARE-03204 itself derives, the anti-farming check not tripping (no_show_terminations_30d 0, completed_trips_30d 118). I do not reach that outcome because POL-NS-04 displaces it, which is its stated effect; nothing about your driving or waiting is criticised here.

I reject the two specific points your advocate raised. First, MSG-03204-003's reference to 'the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side' cannot defeat limb (a): that limb turns on the type of content a message carries, and POL-NS-03 confines any assertion that a named place is or is not this pickup to a venue_id or a party statement in the chat log, neither of which places the rider anywhere but the pin her own device recorded. Second, the chat header does not reconcile with its body (last_message_at 13:19:47 against MSG-03204-002 sent 13:20:27), but that is not a POL-NS-08(c) chat defect: the msg_id sequence 001 to 003 is intact, the log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, and it contains no gap over 5 minutes. The log therefore remains COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and is usable.

On the amount and the record: EV-FARE-03204 charges a cancellation_fee of 4.50 with total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole 4.50 is still outstanding and is what is returned. Every artifact this ruling rests on (EV-TRIP-03204, EV-GPS-03204, EV-CHAT-03204, EV-FARE-03204) is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap on a fact carried by two independent artifacts is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 escalation floor. EV-ADVIS-03204-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0: its absence carries no fact, it makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable to either side, and it is not relied on here - no traffic advisory could matter in any event, because the trace shows a single unbroken in-geofence run of 400 seconds. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was true, and the driver-education referral in POL-NS-01 attaches only where a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE code has been mis-selected, which is not this case. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may lodge one appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this is about the SGD 4.50 no-show fee charged on trip TRP-03204 (EV-FARE-03204: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED). I am refunding it in full to the rider and paying the driver nothing.

The driver's side of the case is first made out, and I accept it. EV-TRIP-03204 shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 13:17:57, the wait timer started two seconds later, and the driver cancelled at 13:24:38 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. EV-GPS-03204 places the driver at 41 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 13:17:57 to 13:24:37 - one continuous 400-second dwell, measured from the first in-geofence fix, against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying fix falls at 13:17:57 itself (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0) and the driver was stationary, not travelling at 15 km/h or more, so POL-NS-05 does not fire and the 400-second dwell stands. POL-NS-06 shows no shortfall: the measured dwell is 220 seconds over the minimum and run_count is 1, so there is no second in-geofence interval for anyone to sum. POL-NS-01(d) is met - no boarding event, terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW, 221 seconds after the required dwell elapsed, with no_show_threshold_sec null. The fare line reconciles: 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect.

None of that saves the fee, because POL-NS-04 applies and all three of its limbs hold. (a) Inside the waiting window the rider sent three messages (EV-CHAT-03204: 13:18:27, 13:19:47 and 13:20:27); the first asks which car the driver is in and says she cannot see him, which is exactly the locating-or-coordinating content limb (a) describes. (b) The log holds no driver message at all, so nothing was posted within 120 seconds of any of those messages, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app call was placed before the driver ended the trip. Opening a message is not replying: MSG-03204-003 was read at 13:20:07 and the driver still wrote nothing and called no one before cancelling at 13:24:38. (c) The rider's own track in EV-GPS-03204 places her device between 15.07 m and 22.11 m from the pickup pin across 68 fixes spanning 13:15:58 to 13:26:00 - every qualifying fix well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius. A driver who serves his clock but cancels on a rider who is at the pin and signalling that she cannot find him has not completed the pickup, and POL-NS-04 refunds the fee in full and says no driver compensation is payable. The driver's figure of SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-03204 derived.money.driver_compensation, 80 per cent of 4.50) is therefore not paid: POL-NS-07 pays only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-04 does. For completeness, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check would not have tripped in any event - no_show_terminations_30d is 0 and completed_trips_30d is 118 - and I have not used prior_no_show_flags, a context-only lifetime counter.

Two driver points I do not accept. First, the rider's mention of 'the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side' does not undo limb (a): that limb turns on whether the message is locating or coordinating, and it plainly is, and the wording cannot be used to place her away from the pin when her own track puts her 15 to 22 m from it - no party may assert that a named place is or is not the same venue on general knowledge (POL-NS-03). Second, the chat log header shows last_message_at 13:19:47 while MSG-03204-002 is sent at 13:20:27; that is a header inconsistency, but it is not a POL-NS-08(c) defect, because the msg_id sequence 001 to 003 is intact and the log holds 3 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3.

Nothing here needs a human reviewer. The trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100.0 per cent coverage, zero gaps and both tracks present; the chat log and trip record are COMPLETE at weight 1.0; the fare breakdown reconciles; so no POL-NS-08 limb (a) to (d) is engaged and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-03204-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and is moot - the rider disclosed it correctly, and with a single 400-second run there is no second interval for an advisory to permit anyone to sum. Confidence is 0.90: every artifact that carries the deciding facts - the chat log, the GPS trace and the trip record - is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, so nothing discounts the finding. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this refund executes automatically. No clause produces a referral on these facts: the arrival marker was true, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the reason code used is one POL-NS-01(d) recognises.

To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged on trip TRP-03204 is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is paid to the driver. The case turns on POL-NS-04.

Rider — your claim is upheld. POL-NS-04 exonerates you and returns the whole fee. Limb (a): EV-CHAT-03204 shows you sent MSG-03204-001 at 13:18:27, inside the waiting window that ran from the driver's arrival marker at 13:17:57 to his cancellation at 13:24:38, and that message both asks the driver's position and says you cannot see the vehicle, so it is locating-and-coordinating on its own; MSG-03204-002 (13:20:27) and MSG-03204-003 (13:19:47) are to the same effect. Limb (b): every message in the log is yours, the driver posted no reply at all, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no reply within 120 seconds and no in-app voice call before termination; the read receipt at 13:20:07 on MSG-03204-003 is not a reply. Limb (c): the rider track in EV-GPS-03204 holds 68 qualifying fixes spanning 13:15:58 to 13:26:00, every one of them 15.07 m to 22.11 m from the pickup pin (mean 18.61 m), inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m, for the whole of the waiting window. All three limbs hold, so the SGD 4.50 is refunded in full and driver_compensation_sgd is null.

Driver — I accept the substance of your account, and the fee does not fail for the reasons you might fear. Your arrival at 13:17:57 is on the record as a driver_arrived event and is independently corroborated by the trace: 41 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, the first at 13:17:57, satisfying POL-NS-01(a), (b) and POL-NS-02; a continuous in-geofence dwell of 400 seconds to 13:24:37 against the 180-second free waiting period read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, satisfying POL-NS-01(c); and termination by you at 13:24:38 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event and platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec null, satisfying POL-NS-01(d). Your counterparty statement 'I waited the full time' is consistent with that record and is not contradicted by anything; it carries no weight_multiplier, so it enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of my confidence cap. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: dwell_start_offset_sec is 0.0, the marker coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the marker is not false and no clock is recomputed. POL-NS-06 discloses no shortfall — the measured shortfall is -220 seconds, a 220-second surplus — and run_count is 1, so there is no second interval for limb (i) to sum; that limb is in any event unavailable to anyone, because EV-ADVIS-03204-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, as the rider correctly disclosed.

What defeats the fee is not your arrival or your dwell but POL-NS-04: you served out the clock but never answered three locating messages from a rider whose own device sat 15-22 m from your pin. Your two subsidiary points do not change that. The message text 'taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side' cannot be used to place the rider anywhere else: POL-NS-03 confines any same-venue or different-venue assertion to a venue_id or to a party statement in the chat log, no party statement puts her away from the pin, her own admissible track puts her at it, and POL-NS-03 does not apply in any event because your stationary fixes lie INSIDE the arrival radius, not outside it. The chat log's header/body mismatch (last_message_at 13:19:47 against MSG-03204-002 sent 13:20:27) engages no limb of POL-NS-08(c): the msg_id sequence 001-003 is intact, the log holds 3 messages, equal to trip_record.chat_message_count 3, and there is no gap of more than 5 minutes spanning the arrival marker — so the log stays COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and no down-weighting follows.

Your POL-NS-07 claim of SGD 3.60 is therefore rejected on the clause's own terms: it compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full AND no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 sits inside that range. The anti-farming test would not have tripped in any event (no_show_terminations_30d 0, completed_trips_30d 118, quotient 0.00), and I have used no context-only profile field: POL-GEN-01 permits only no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d for that check, and prior_no_show_flags was cited only to say it may not be substituted.

Amount and integrity. The sum refunded is SGD 4.50, read from EV-FARE-03204's cancellation_fee line and total_charged, which equal platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd on the trip record; payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so nothing has yet been returned. No POL-NS-08 limb (a) to (d) is engaged on any artifact the ruling reads — no clock skew, no trace gap over 120 seconds (100.0% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0, both tracks present), no chat defect, and the fare line reconciles — and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so the case is decidable on the money rather than held. My confidence of 0.9 sits within a cap of 1.0, the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-CHAT-03204, EV-TRIP-03204 and EV-GPS-03204, all COMPLETE at weight 1.0). The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so none is made; this ruling is provisional and either party may appeal it under POL-GEN-04.

Rider: your dispute is upheld. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee shown on EV-FARE-03204 (cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded to you in full. Driver: the fee does not stand against you? No - the fee is not retained, because POL-NS-04, not POL-NS-01, decides this case, and POL-NS-07 pays you nothing where a clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee.

POL-NS-04 has three limbs and all three hold on the records as they stand. (a) Inside the waiting window (your arrival marker at 13:17:57 to the cancellation at 13:24:38) EV-CHAT-03204 carries three rider messages: 13:18:27 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you', 13:19:47 'hello, Siti here, im at the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side', and 13:20:27 'hello? are you here'. The first alone both asks for the driver's position and states the rider cannot see the vehicle, which is locating/coordinating content. (b) No driver message appears anywhere in the log, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no reply was posted within 120 seconds of any message and no in-app call was made before the trip was terminated. MSG-03204-003 was read at 13:20:07, but a read receipt is not a reply. (c) The rider's own track in EV-GPS-03204 (68 fixes, 13:15:58 to 13:26:00) sits 15.07 m to 22.11 m from the pickup pin, all 68 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius - the majority, indeed all, of them.

Everything else on the record is agreed and I accept it. The driver did arrive: 41 consecutive in-geofence fixes from 13:17:57, the same second as the arrived event, inside the 50 m STANDARD radius; he then held position 400 seconds, above the 180-second free waiting period in force on this record (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and cancelled at 13:24:38 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, 221 seconds after the dwell elapsed. POL-NS-06 therefore shows a 220-second surplus, not a shortfall, and POL-NS-05 is not engaged because the first in-geofence fix coincides with the marker (dwell_start_offset 0.0). Those findings make out POL-NS-01, but POL-NS-07 compensates you only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it' - POL-NS-04 is such a clause, so the claimed 3.60 (80 percent of 4.50) is not payable and driver_compensation_sgd is null.

The points raised for the driver do not change this. The rider's naming of 'the taxi stand near Lim Chu Kang Road side' does not defeat limb (a) or place her away from the pin: limb (a) turns on the content being locating/coordinating, her track keeps her within 22 m of the pin throughout, and POL-NS-03 confines any assertion that two places are the same venue, block or entrance to a venue_id or a party statement in the chat log - no inference from general geographic knowledge is permitted. The chat log's header (last_message_at 13:19:47) disagrees with MSG-03204-002 (sent 13:20:27), but that anomaly meets none of the POL-NS-08(c) chat defects (msg_id sequence intact, message_count 3 matching trip_record.chat_message_count 3, no 5-minute gap) and is immaterial, because neither message drew a reply.

Weights: the facts that decide this refund - the rider's messages, the driver's silence, the rider's presence - are carried by EV-CHAT-03204, EV-GPS-03204 and EV-TRIP-03204, each COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence 0.90 stands above the 0.70 floor. EV-ADVIS-03204-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, as disclosed; nothing in this ruling rests on it - POL-NS-06(i) cannot be run on a missing advisory and is moot in any event, since there is a single unbroken 400-second run. driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used; POL-NS-07's anti-farming check reads no_show_terminations_30d (0) and the 0.00 quotient and does not trip. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so the case is decided rather than held, and no referral is produced: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker is not false and qualifying in-geofence fixes exist, and no other clause directs one.

The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes on issue; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

The anti-farming check does not trip: it reads only driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d (0, below the four required) and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (118, the quotient 0.00 not above 0.08), and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags, a lifetime counter, for either of them.
